tokens.name: mm-paper
tokens.usage: Page background (dark: bg). Near-white with a whisper of warmth, never cream. Text tokens are checked against it.

tokens.name: mm-surface
tokens.usage: Panels, tables and the editor where a lift is needed; secondary button and input fill.

tokens.name: mm-raised
tokens.usage: Floating layers: popovers, menus, dialogs, the command palette. In dark mode elevation is shown by this lighter step, not by shadow.

tokens.name: mm-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, table header bands, sidebars, the details blade, inline code and tags. Hover tone for table rows.

tokens.name: mm-rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and panel borders, 1px. Decorative only (1.3:1): never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: mm-control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, checkboxes and secondary buttons. 3.2:1 on mm-paper (dark 3.6:1 on mm-surface).

tokens.name: mm-text
tokens.usage: Ink. Primary text on mm-paper, mm-surface, mm-sunken and mm-raised (17.6:1 light, 15.1:1 dark). Also inverse fills (selected segment, filter pill, tooltip) and the focus ring.

tokens.name: mm-text-2
tokens.usage: Ink-2. Secondary text, field labels, table headers, metadata captions, tags. 7.3:1 on mm-paper, 6.8:1 on mm-sunken; 7.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: mm-text-3
tokens.usage: Ink-3. Tertiary text, captions, panel icons, context chart series. 5.2:1 on mm-paper; 4.5:1 on dark mm-surface. On dark mm-raised it falls to 4.1:1, so captions in popovers and dialogs use mm-text-2 in Peat.

tokens.name: mm-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on an mm-text fill: selected segment, selected filter pill, tooltips, the focus ring offset.

tokens.name: mm-primary
tokens.usage: Burnt sienna as text: links, the active tab underline, the current lineage node border, the brand. 5.1:1 on mm-paper (dark 7.6:1). Under 5% of any screen, at most once per row. Never a status.

tokens.name: mm-primary-fill
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and other solid burnt-sienna marks. Carries mm-on-primary text (5.2:1 light, 5.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: mm-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of mm-primary-fill; increases contrast with mm-on-primary (6.9:1 light).

tokens.name: mm-on-primary
tokens.usage: Label text on mm-primary-fill, mm-primary-hover and mm-danger-fill.

tokens.name: mm-primary-tint
tokens.usage: Selected row or nav item, ::selection, active filter chip, the current lineage node, agent tint. mm-text on it.

tokens.name: mm-contour
tokens.usage: The contour motif only (from USGS topo brown): empty states, sign-in, loading, marketing, isoline charts. Never UI state. 3.9:1, decorative.

tokens.name: mm-contour-index
tokens.usage: The heavier every-fifth index contour line.

tokens.name: mm-success
tokens.usage: Moss. Succeeded, healthy, allowed. Text and icons on mm-paper (5.2:1) and mm-success-soft; observed lineage edges (dashed).

tokens.name: mm-success-soft
tokens.usage: Moss soft fill behind success status pills and callouts. mm-text or mm-success on it.

tokens.name: mm-warning
tokens.usage: Ochre for icons, fills, marks and cycle edges: stale, truncated, expiring. 3.9:1 light, so never body text; use mm-warning-text.

tokens.name: mm-warning-text
tokens.usage: Ochre as text: warning pill labels and messages. 5.5:1 on mm-paper.

tokens.name: mm-warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ochre soft fill behind warning pills and callouts. mm-text or mm-warning-text on it.

tokens.name: mm-info
tokens.usage: Slate. Running, informational, and people as opposed to agents. Text on mm-paper (5.8:1); the one highlighted chart series where burnt sienna would read as brand.

tokens.name: mm-info-soft
tokens.usage: Slate soft fill: info pills and callouts, the people tint.

tokens.name: mm-danger
tokens.usage: Crimson. Failed, denied, destructive, input errors. Text on mm-paper (6.3:1). Always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: mm-danger-fill
tokens.usage: Danger button fill, with mm-on-primary (6.5:1 light).

tokens.name: mm-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Crimson soft fill behind failed pills and error callouts. mm-text or mm-danger on it.

tokens.name: mm-code-bg
tokens.usage: The SQL editor and code blocks: a warm near-black in both themes.

tokens.name: mm-code-text
tokens.usage: Default text on mm-code-bg (15.4:1).

tokens.name: mm-syn-keyword
tokens.usage: SQL keywords on mm-code-bg (burnt-sienna tint).

tokens.name: mm-syn-function
tokens.usage: Function names on mm-code-bg (ochre).

tokens.name: mm-syn-string
tokens.usage: String literals on mm-code-bg (moss tint).

tokens.name: mm-syn-number
tokens.usage: Numbers on mm-code-bg (slate tint).

tokens.name: mm-syn-comment
tokens.usage: Comments on mm-code-bg, italic. Ink-3 lifted to stay above 4.5:1 on the editor.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Marketing and sign-in headlines only. One per view.

styles.name: display-title
styles.usage: Page titles: the asset name, Discover, Insights. One display title per view region.

styles.name: display-kpi
styles.usage: KPI and stat values, with tabular-nums. Range 32–40px.

styles.name: display-section
styles.usage: Large section titles and empty-state headlines. Never below 24px; smaller headings use heading.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Headings under 24px: dialog titles, article sections.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Daily order totals, deduplicated and joined to customers_dim.
styles.usage: All reading text. Prose measure 60–75 characters.

styles.name: dense
styles.usage: Tables, sidebars, metadata, toolbars, tabs, menus.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels and table column headers. Sentence case, mm-text-2. Never uppercase mono.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions and helper text. Nothing smaller than 13px.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Machine strings beside body text: MRNs, IDs, paths. About 1px smaller than the surrounding text.

styles.name: mono-dense
styles.usage: Types, IDs and result-grid cells in 15px tables; log timestamps.

styles.name: mono-editor
styles.usage: The SQL editor and code blocks.

styles.name: keycap
styles.usage: Keyboard keys in menus, search inputs and the command palette.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Base grid unit. Icon-to-label gap in tags and pills.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls; icon-to-label gap in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Cell padding in tables; menu item padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding (lower bound); mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding (upper bound); blade section padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between panels in a column.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between major page regions; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Controls, inputs, tags, keycaps, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, menus, buttons, lineage nodes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the command palette.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, status pills and filter pills only.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs, default.

tokens.name: control-h-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and toolbar controls.

tokens.name: row-compact
tokens.usage: Table rows, compact density; command palette rows.

tokens.name: row-default
tokens.usage: Table rows, default density.

tokens.name: blade-w
tokens.usage: Details blade width (36rem).

tokens.name: target-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum interactive target on touch (24px on desktop).

shadow.note: Floating layers only. Panels and tables never carry a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, toasts. Two layers tinted with ink, never neutral black.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the command palette.
